title: Credentia
jobDescription:
Build Healthcare Professional App
Mobile App Development Posted Aug 19, 2026
Looking to have a Healthcare Professional App MVP developed

Overview
I'm looking for an experienced developer to help build an MVP for a new healthcare-focused mobile application.

The application will initially target dental professionals, with plans to expand into additional healthcare professions.

I'm looking for someone who can help turn a product concept into a polished, scalable MVP while maintaining strong attention to security, privacy, user permissions, and database architecture.

Scope of Work
The initial MVP will include:

User registration and authentication
Multiple user types/roles
Professional profiles
Search and filtering
User-generated content
Ratings/reviews
Private and public content with different visibility rules
Professional networking
Peer to peer communication and Direct messaging
Community/social features
Notifications
Basic administrative dashboard
User verification
Content reporting and moderation
Location-based functionality
The application will involve different users having different permissions and access to different types of information, so experience designing secure role-based access is extremely important.
Experience with:

Mobile app deployment
App Store and Google Play submission
Experience building social platforms, professional networks, marketplaces, review platforms, or other applications with complex permissions is highly preferred.
Security & Privacy
Security is a major priority.

The application will contain information that should only be accessible to specific user types.

I need the underlying database/backend permissions designed correctly rather than relying solely on frontend/UI restrictions.

The architecture should also be scalable so additional healthcare professions and features can be added later without rebuilding the application.

What I Need From You
Please include the following in your proposal:

Examples of applications you've personally built
Links/screenshots to previous work
Your recommended backend/database approach
Estimated development timeline
Estimated project cost
Whether you work independently or with a team

I'm looking for someone who:

Has strong app launching experience
Understands backend architecture
Writes clean, maintainable applications
Understands mobile UX
Communicates well
Can identify technical problems before they become expensive
The initial project is an MVP, but the goal is to build the foundation for a much larger platform.Is interested in potentially continuing beyond the MVP
I'm more concerned with quality, security, and scalability than simply getting the app completed as quickly as possible.
